attributes.name: walking_steps
attributes.text: The person walks with alternating steps across the floor.
attributes.definition: The feet alternate steps and the hips travel a clear distance over the floor.

attributes.name: stays_in_place_legs_moving
attributes.text: The legs move repeatedly but the body stays on the same spot.
attributes.definition: The legs lift or bend repeatedly while the hips do not travel across the floor.

attributes.name: both_feet_leave_floor
attributes.text: The body rises so the feet leave the floor.
attributes.definition: There is a moment when the supporting foot or feet are off the floor and the whole body is in the air.

attributes.name: body_lowers
attributes.text: The whole body lowers toward the floor.
attributes.definition: The hips move clearly downward from standing height during the main phase.

attributes.name: body_rises_from_low
attributes.text: The whole body rises from a low position to standing.
attributes.definition: The hips start low (seated or crouched) and move up to standing height during the action.

attributes.name: single_leg_support
attributes.text: The body is balanced on one leg during the main motion.
attributes.definition: For the key phase, only one foot is on the floor carrying the body weight.

attributes.name: unsteady_balance
attributes.text: The body sways or loses balance.
attributes.definition: The torso and hips wobble irregularly, or the body collapses, rather than moving in a controlled path.

attributes.name: weight_shift_forward
attributes.text: Body weight shifts from the back foot onto the front foot.
attributes.definition: The hips and torso move forward over the front foot as the main motion is delivered, while the feet stay in place.

attributes.name: whole_body_still_hands_work
attributes.text: The legs and torso stay still while only the hands and arms move.
attributes.definition: Hips, legs and torso remain nearly fixed for the whole action; all motion is in the arms or hands.

attributes.name: small_foot_adjustments
attributes.text: The feet take small adjusting steps during an otherwise upper-body action.
attributes.definition: A few small, irregular steps occur while the main motion is in the arms; the body does not travel far.

attributes.name: trunk_rotates_with_hips
attributes.text: The whole trunk turns around the vertical axis.
attributes.definition: The torso and hips rotate together to one side and back as part of the main movement.
